description.p: House-rule casting system: spellcasters use a pool of mana points (MP) instead of spell slots. Enable the Mana Points Casting character option to add the MP tracker and cost tables to a character.

p.em: Note: mana points per level are subject to change at the DM’s discretion.

description.p: Instead of using spell slots, spellcasters use mana points (MP). This gives more liberty over how many spells they can cast at what level.
Enable this option to grant the Mana Points feature, which tracks your MP pool by caster level and lists mana costs by spell level.
Aurora note: The builder still displays normal spell slots. Treat those as unused; cast by spending mana from the Mana Points tracker on your sheet.

p.em: Mana points per level are subject to change at the DM’s discretion.
Additional rules on page 2 of the house-rules document are not included in this pack (content not available in the extract).

setters.set: Spellcasters use a mana point pool instead of spell slots. Grants the Mana Points tracker and cost tables.

description.p: Instead of using spell slots, you cast spells by spending mana points (MP) from your pool. You regain all spent mana points when you finish a long rest. Cantrips do not cost mana.
Your spellcaster level determines your maximum mana points and the highest-level spell you can cast, as shown below.

p.em: Note: mana points per level are subject to change at the DM’s discretion.

description.p: You cannot cast a spell of a level higher than your Max Spell Level, even if you have enough mana remaining.

p.em: Page 2 of the house-rules document (if any further casting rules) is not implemented here.
